nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: GM WT spec guide lists the Standard Range pack as '475 volt' (max charge voltage, mapped to 400v class); LT Standard Range inferred to share the pack. Corrects the earlier 800v value (Max pack).

Estimated: GM's 2026 specification guide gives 475 V for the 14-module Standard Range pack, which is a charging voltage rather than a nominal one; The Weekly Driver (EPA filing) gives 470 V nominal. Either way a 400 V-class pack, not the 800 V split-pack charging of the Max Range.

chemistry.notes: thinkEV lists NMC for the 2026 Silverado EV (model level); InsideEVs also describes the Silverado pack as NMC pouch cells. Not trim-specific.
Estimated: InsideEVs describes the Silverado EV pack as NMC pouch cells (24-module pack); thinkEV lists NMC for 2026; same Ultium cells in all pack sizes.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated (owner to confirm the scaling basis): LT Standard Range inferred to share the 14-module WT Standard Range pack (no cited page says so; EPA 283 mi vs WT 286 mi). GM spec guide gives no kWh; 204 kWh usable (24-module pack, InsideEVs) x 14/24 = 119.

Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists the Standard Range pack as 119 kWh "as published"; GM does not say whether this is usable or total, so it may be a gross figure. Scaled check: 204 kWh x 14/24 modules = 119 kWh (module counts from the GM 2026 Silverado EV guide: 14 / 20 / 24 modules).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Chevrolet's battery-preconditioning quick-start guide and Charging App help text (chevrolet.com returns 403, so read only as a search excerpt) describe the car automatically preconditioning the battery when you route to a DC fast charger in Google Maps, and a manual Start under Next charge. Not read on a page for this exact model year; applied to this model line on the same Ultium software. UNVERIFIED, weakest for 2023-2024 cars.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM WT spec guide gives 'up to 220 kW' for the Standard Range pack; LT Standard Range inferred to share that pack (not stated by any cited page). Corrects the earlier 350 kW value (Max pack).

Estimated: same Standard Range 14-module pack (119 kWh, 220 kW) as the Work Truck on the 2026 GM guide; LT carries the same pack per The Weekly Driver (Standard Range offered only on WT and LT). GM 2026 WT spec guide lists the Standard Range (14 MOD) pack. 475 V up to 220 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM 2026 WT spec guide lists the Standard Range (14 MOD) pack. Charging module 11.5 kW high-voltage on Standard Range.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: GM 2026 WT spec guide lists the Standard Range (14 MOD) pack. Low-80% time to charge 40 min and 74 miles added in 10 min; column mapping to this pack inferred from the page layout (4WT 74 mi, 5WT 111 mi, 8WT 124 mi).
